rationale: The AMD Ryzen 7 5700X is a desktop processor, an electronic integrated circuit classified as a processor or controller under heading 8542.31.
raw:
A desktop CPU like the AMD Ryzen 7 5700X is an electronic integrated circuit, a processor, and falls under HTS 8542.31. Processors and controllers are in 8542.31.00, and the statistical suffix is 8542.31.0000 (since 2022 the HTS has 8542.31.00 with 10-digit stat suffixes such as 8542.31.0001 and so on).

I recall that for 8542.31.00 the statistical suffixes are 8542.31.0001 for "Processors and controllers, whether or not combining memory... " and the 2022-and-later 8542.31.0000 is with no suffix. The most commonly used code for CPUs is 8542310000. I'll go with that.

rationale: An 18650 rechargeable lithium-ion cell (with charger) falls under heading 8507.60 for lithium-ion accumulators. I chose the 8507.60.0010 suffix for cylindrical cells, but the exact statistical suffix is uncertain without supplied tariff evidence.
raw:
The product is an 18650 lithium-ion rechargeable cell, sold with a charger. The relevant heading is 8507.60 (lithium-ion accumulators). The 18650 cell is cylindrical, and the HTS subheadings under 8507.60.00 are:

- 8507.60.0010: cylindrical cells, 18650 type
- 8507.60.0020: other lithium-ion batteries of a kind used as the primary source of power for electric vehicles
- 8507.60.0030 and 8507.60.0090: other

The exact current statistical suffixes are not certain. As I recall, 8507.60.0010 covers "Cylindrical cells..." and 8507.60.0020 covers "Other batteries of a kind used as primary source of electrical power of electric vehicles of subheading 8703.40 – 8703.90". The "other" suffix is 8507.60.0090.

Because the batteries are sold with a charger, they may be a set, but the battery is the essential character, so heading 8507 still applies. The 8507.60.0010 suffix looks right for a single cell of this type, though some customs rulings place 18650 cells under 8507.60.0090. I lean toward 8507.60.0010 because the product is a lithium-ion battery in cylindrical form, and the pack may contain just one cell.

No evidence was supplied, so confidence is limited.
